title: Unified combined report_result.json (envelope 2.0.0)
description: One file per document: <output>/<uploaded file name>_<ext>/report_result.json. A derived export: the owning OCR service keeps the OCR results, corrections and verification, the person-image manifest keeps the images. ocr.payload is embedded exactly as the service's GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/results returned it, with its own native schema_version (never rewritten); it is null when OCR has produced nothing. Each pipeline's status stands on its own. Envelope 1.x was the IR-only envelope of the person-image integration; the blocks processing / ocr / person_images keep their 1.x meaning in 2.0.0.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS envelope (not of any OCR payload).

document_id.description: The unified document id (equal to the owning service's document id).

generated_at.description: UTC, when this file was last rebuilt

document_type_source.description: legacy = uploaded to IR_OCR before the merge

detected_kind.description: pdf | docx | png | jpeg | tiff, from the file's content

sha256.description: of the kept original, which the person-image pipeline also reads

intake_id.description: set when the upload waited for a manual type choice

classification.description: How the document type was decided: file facts, text source, both detectors' verdicts, markers, scores, reasons, warnings. No document text is stored. null for legacy documents.

ocr_document_status.description: the service's own document status (queued, processing, completed, failed, verified)

ocr_extraction_status.description: results.extraction_status of the native payload (complete, partial, failed)

ocr_progress.description: current step and elapsed seconds while OCR runs

image_extraction_status.description: status of the LATEST image run; not_applicable for charge sheets, which get no person-image extraction

pipeline.description: which unchanged service produced the payload

payload.description: the service's native ResultsResponse: document, results, field_corrections

run_id.description: the run whose images are listed (newest usable run)

items.description: paths relative to the document's output folder; image bytes are never embedded

review.description: Summary only. The saved corrections themselves are in ocr.payload.field_corrections; the full correction history stays in the owning service (GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/corrections).

extractor.description: which implementation produced the OCR payload: repository, branch, commit, how it is run
